title: Happy Horse 1.0 Unified Video Generation Model
summary: A high-performance AI video generator from Alibaba's Future Life Lab that natively synthesizes synchronized audio and cinematic video in a single-stream transformer. It currently holds the top rank on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena for its superior photorealism and lip-sync accuracy.
research_notes: Utilizes a unified Transformer architecture to process audio and video tokens simultaneously; achieves high speeds using DMD-2 distillation for 8-step generation.

evolution.summary: Since its pseudonymous debut in early 2026, Happy Horse has transitioned from a leaderboard mystery to a cornerstone of Alibaba's AI strategy. It has introduced native 4K generation, multi-shot consistency, and a roadmap for a 15-billion-parameter open-source version.
